title: 污水紫外線消毒~Ultraviolet wastewater disinfection
focus: UV 透光、流場、劑量與驗證範圍~UV transmission, hydraulics, fluence and validation envelope
summary: 本課以UV 透光、流場、劑量與驗證範圍為主線，從前處理與指標菌基線、透光率與光程、照度與時間乘積、水力通道與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops uv transmission, hydraulics, fluence and validation envelope through ten connected units, beginning with pretreatment and indicator baseline, transmittance and optical path, irradiance and exposure time, hydraulic paths and short-circuiting. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 前處理與指標菌基線~Pretreatment and indicator baseline
units.mechanism: 消毒目標需區分指標菌與病原；流量和採樣方法決定如何比較處理前後結果。~Distinguish indicator organisms from pathogens; flow and sampling methods determine valid before/after comparisons.
units.model: 原創教學假設：流量=1000 m³/d；指標菌=100 CFU/100 mL。模型 Nday=Q×10000×C，代入得到 1e+09 CFU/d。適用邊界：只計培養法的指標菌通量；不能直接推成所有病原或感染風險。~Original teaching assumptions: Flow=1000 m³/d; indicator organisms=100 CFU/100 mL. Model Nday=Q×10000×C gives 1e+09 CFU/d. Applicability: Culture-based indicator-organism flux only, not all pathogens or infection risk.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「前處理與指標菌基線」的觀測點。記錄檢出限、培養法與採樣時刻，避免把未檢出當零。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for pretreatment and indicator baseline. Record detection limit, culture method and sample time; do not equate nondetection to zero. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用單一指標菌檢測宣稱所有病原已消失。診斷與介入：確認微生物方法及檢出限，與同時段流量配對。~One indicator test is used to claim elimination of all pathogens. Diagnostic response: Confirm microbial method/detection limit and pair with matched-period flow.
units.misconception: 清澈的出水等於不需要消毒。~Clear effluent does not need disinfection.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:1000→1200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1e+09 變為 1.2e+09 CFU/d。用「前處理與指標菌基線」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:1000→1200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1e+09 to 1.2e+09 CFU/d. Explain the direction using pretreatment and indicator baseline, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 透光率與光程~Transmittance and optical path
units.mechanism: UVT 必須標明波長與光程；同一水樣的更長光程會衰減更多光。~UVT requires wavelength and path length; longer paths through the same water attenuate more light.
units.model: 原創教學假設：1 cm UVT=0.80；光程=3 cm。模型 T=T1^l，代入得到 0.512 fraction。適用邊界：均質吸收且忽略散射；透光率不是微生物去除率。~Original teaching assumptions: 1-cm UVT=0.80; path length=3 cm. Model T=T1^l gives 0.512 fraction. Applicability: Homogeneous absorption without scattering; transmittance is not microbial removal.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「透光率與光程」的觀測點。校正光程與空白，再比較不同水樣 UVT。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for transmittance and optical path. Calibrate path length/blank and compare UVT across samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把 1 cm UVT 當作整座反應器的透光率。診斷與介入：確認波長、光程及空白，再查水質與顆粒變化。~One-centimeter UVT is treated as whole-reactor transmittance. Diagnostic response: Confirm wavelength, path length and blank, then check water/particle changes.
units.misconception: UVT 是與光程無關的固定百分比。~UVT is a fixed percentage independent of path length.
units.practice: 只改變 T1:0.80→0.90，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.512 變為 0.729 fraction。用「透光率與光程」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only T1:0.80→0.90, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.512 to 0.729 fraction. Explain the direction using transmittance and optical path, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 照度與時間乘積~Irradiance and exposure time
units.mechanism: 均勻場中的 E×t 只教會劑量單位，實際微生物路徑經歷的光強不相同。~E×t in a uniform field teaches fluence units; actual microorganism trajectories encounter different intensities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：輻照度 E=2 mW/cm²；曝光時間 t=15 s。模型 D=Et，代入得到 30 mJ/cm²。適用邊界：均勻單粒子光場假設；不是經驗證反應器 RED 或法定劑量。~Original teaching assumptions: Irradiance E=2 mW/cm²; exposure t=15 s. Model D=Et gives 30 mJ/cm². Applicability: Uniform single-particle field; not a validated reactor RED or regulatory dose.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「照度與時間乘積」的觀測點。對照 UVT、燈衰退、流量與經驗證反應器資料。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for irradiance and exposure time. Compare UVT, lamp aging, flow and validated-reactor data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以燈具銘牌功率直接當水中照度。診斷與介入：回到反應器驗證資料與流況，避免把均勻場示例作為現場劑量。~Lamp nameplate power is substituted for in-water irradiance. Diagnostic response: Return to reactor-validation/hydraulic data rather than using the uniform-field example as a field dose.
units.misconception: 單一 E×t 計算就是反應器驗證劑量。~One E×t calculation is the validated reactor dose.
units.practice: 只改變 E:2→1.6 mW/cm²，其餘假設固定；結果應由 30 變為 24 mJ/cm²。用「照度與時間乘積」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only E:2→1.6 mW/cm², holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 30 to 24 mJ/cm². Explain the direction using irradiance and exposure time, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 水力通道與短流~Hydraulic paths and short-circuiting
units.mechanism: 水位、流量及擋板決定停留分布，名義體積不能辨識繞過燈區的快流。~Level, flow and baffles determine residence distribution; nominal volume does not reveal fast paths bypassing lamps.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效通水體積=0.3 m³；Q=0.02 m³/s。模型 t=V/Q，代入得到 15 s。適用邊界：名義通過時間不等於最低受光時間；燈場與流速分布需驗證。~Original teaching assumptions: Effective wetted volume=0.3 m³; Q=0.02 m³/s. Model t=V/Q gives 15 s. Applicability: Nominal passage time is not minimum UV exposure time; lamp field and velocity distribution require validation.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「水力通道與短流」的觀測點。配對流量與水位，另以示蹤或驗證資料檢查短流。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for hydraulic paths and short-circuiting. Pair flow with water level and check short-circuiting using tracer or validation data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 平均通過時間掩蓋最低曝光路徑。診斷與介入：用水位與示蹤查短流，核對流量是否仍在驗證範圍。~Mean passage time hides minimum-exposure paths. Diagnostic response: Check bypass using level/tracing and verify flow remains within the validated range.
units.misconception: 平均停留時間足夠就所有水都足夠受光。~Adequate mean residence ensures adequate exposure for all water.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:0.02→0.025 m³/s，其餘假設固定；結果應由 15 變為 12 s。用「水力通道與短流」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:0.02→0.025 m³/s, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 15 to 12 s. Explain the direction using hydraulic paths and short-circuiting, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 燈老化與套管污垢~Lamp aging and sleeve fouling
units.mechanism: 燈輸出衰退與套管污垢會共同降低水中照度，兩者需分開診斷與維護紀錄。~Aging lamps and fouled sleeves both reduce in-water irradiance and require separate diagnosis and maintenance records.
units.model: 原創教學假設：新燈有效強度=2 mW/cm²；老化係數=0.8；污垢係數=0.9。模型 Eeff=E0 fa ff，代入得到 1.44 mW/cm²。適用邊界：獨立乘法損失的教學近似，需用經校正感測器檢驗。~Original teaching assumptions: New intensity=2 mW/cm²; aging factor=0.8; fouling factor=0.9. Model Eeff=E0 fa ff gives 1.44 mW/cm². Applicability: Teaching approximation of independent losses; validate with a calibrated sensor.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「燈老化與套管污垢」的觀測點。清潔前後讀值分開，避免把污垢歸因於燈齡。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for lamp aging and sleeve fouling. Separate pre/post-cleaning readings so fouling is not mistaken for lamp aging. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 清套管後仍低輸出卻忽略老化或感測漂移。診斷與介入：分別檢查老化、污垢與感測偏差，再依程序驗證恢復。~Low output after cleaning is attributed only to residual fouling, ignoring aging or sensor drift. Diagnostic response: Check aging, fouling and sensor bias separately and verify recovery by the applicable procedure.
units.misconception: 只要燈亮就保持原始消毒能力。~A lit lamp retains its original disinfection capability.
units.practice: 只改變 ff:0.9→0.75，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1.44 變為 1.2 mW/cm²。用「燈老化與套管污垢」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only ff:0.9→0.75, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1.44 to 1.2 mW/cm². Explain the direction using lamp aging and sleeve fouling, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 顆粒遮蔽與水質變動~Particle shielding and water-quality change
units.mechanism: 附著於顆粒內部的微生物可能受遮蔽；低濁度與高 UVT 仍需搭配顆粒及微生物證據。~Microbes within particles can be shielded; low turbidity and high UVT still require particle and microbiological evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：1 cm UVT=0.80；光程=3 cm。模型 T=T1^l，代入得到 0.512 fraction。適用邊界：均質吸收且忽略散射；透光率不是微生物去除率。~Original teaching assumptions: 1-cm UVT=0.80; path length=3 cm. Model T=T1^l gives 0.512 fraction. Applicability: Homogeneous absorption without scattering; transmittance is not microbial removal.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「顆粒遮蔽與水質變動」的觀測點。校正光程與空白，再比較不同水樣 UVT。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for particle shielding and water-quality change. Calibrate path length/blank and compare UVT across samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只以濁度預測所有 UV 表現。診斷與介入：確認波長、光程及空白，再查水質與顆粒變化。~Turbidity alone is used to predict all UV performance. Diagnostic response: Confirm wavelength, path length and blank, then check water/particle changes.
units.misconception: 相同 UVT 的兩種水必有相同消毒效果。~Two waters with equal UVT necessarily have equal disinfection.
units.practice: 只改變 T1:0.80→0.90，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.512 變為 0.729 fraction。用「顆粒遮蔽與水質變動」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only T1:0.80→0.90, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.512 to 0.729 fraction. Explain the direction using particle shielding and water-quality change, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 生物驗證與對數降低~Biodosimetry and log reduction
units.mechanism: 用指定挑戰微生物及受控條件驗證反應器，再與校正曲線相連；檢測方法決定可聲稱的降低量。~Validate with specified challenge organisms and controlled conditions linked to a calibration curve; the analytical method limits the claimed reduction.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Nin=100000；Nout=100（相同計數單位）。模型 LRV=log10(Nin/Nout)，代入得到 3 log10。適用邊界：需檢測限與回收率；未檢出不能當零。~Original teaching assumptions: Nin=100000; Nout=100 in matching count units. Model LRV=log10(Nin/Nout) gives 3 log10. Applicability: Requires detection limits and recovery; nondetect is not zero.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「生物驗證與對數降低」的觀測點。列出方法回收率、重複樣本與未檢出上限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for biodosimetry and log reduction. Record method recovery, replicates and nondetect upper bounds. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 未檢出結果被直接代為零而算無限降低。診斷與介入：核對檢出限及水力配對，對未檢出結果使用可支持的下限。~Nondetection is entered as zero to claim infinite reduction. Diagnostic response: Check detection limits/hydraulic pairing and use supportable lower bounds for nondetection.
units.misconception: 指標菌降低量可以不加修正套用所有病原。~Indicator reduction transfers unchanged to every pathogen.
units.practice: 只改變 Nout:100→1000，其餘假設固定；結果應由 3 變為 2 log10。用「生物驗證與對數降低」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Nout:100→1000, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 3 to 2 log10. Explain the direction using biodosimetry and log reduction, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 驗證包絡與負載~Validation envelope and loading
units.mechanism: 可用的運轉區間由經驗證的流量、UVT、燈組與感測條件組成，超出時不能靠外插宣稱達標。~The usable envelope combines validated flow, UVT, lamp configuration and sensing; extrapolation outside it does not prove compliance.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效通水體積=0.3 m³；Q=0.02 m³/s。模型 t=V/Q，代入得到 15 s。適用邊界：名義通過時間不等於最低受光時間；燈場與流速分布需驗證。~Original teaching assumptions: Effective wetted volume=0.3 m³; Q=0.02 m³/s. Model t=V/Q gives 15 s. Applicability: Nominal passage time is not minimum UV exposure time; lamp field and velocity distribution require validation.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「驗證包絡與負載」的觀測點。配對流量與水位，另以示蹤或驗證資料檢查短流。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for validation envelope and loading. Pair flow with water level and check short-circuiting using tracer or validation data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 日平均流量在範圍內就忽略瞬時超量。診斷與介入：用水位與示蹤查短流，核對流量是否仍在驗證範圍。~An acceptable daily mean hides instantaneous excursions. Diagnostic response: Check bypass using level/tracing and verify flow remains within the validated range.
units.misconception: 提高流量後只按平均劑量比例換算就足夠。~Scaling mean fluence with flow is enough after a flow increase.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:0.02→0.025 m³/s，其餘假設固定；結果應由 15 變為 12 s。用「驗證包絡與負載」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:0.02→0.025 m³/s, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 15 to 12 s. Explain the direction using validation envelope and loading, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 感測、警報與失效演練~Sensing, alarms and failure rehearsal
units.mechanism: 離線注入感測偏差、燈組失效與水質突變，檢查警報如何保留異常時段及處理去向。~Inject sensor bias, lamp failure and water-quality changes offline to check alarms, exceptional intervals and water routing.
units.model: 原創教學假設：新燈有效強度=2 mW/cm²；老化係數=0.8；污垢係數=0.9。模型 Eeff=E0 fa ff，代入得到 1.44 mW/cm²。適用邊界：獨立乘法損失的教學近似，需用經校正感測器檢驗。~Original teaching assumptions: New intensity=2 mW/cm²; aging factor=0.8; fouling factor=0.9. Model Eeff=E0 fa ff gives 1.44 mW/cm². Applicability: Teaching approximation of independent losses; validate with a calibrated sensor.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「感測、警報與失效演練」的觀測點。清潔前後讀值分開，避免把污垢歸因於燈齡。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sensing, alarms and failure rehearsal. Separate pre/post-cleaning readings so fouling is not mistaken for lamp aging. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 警報消音被當作水質已恢復。診斷與介入：分別檢查老化、污垢與感測偏差，再依程序驗證恢復。~Acknowledging an alarm is mistaken for restored treatment. Diagnostic response: Check aging, fouling and sensor bias separately and verify recovery by the applicable procedure.
units.misconception: 只有讀值偏低才需要檢查感測器。~Only low readings require sensor checks.
units.practice: 只改變 ff:0.9→0.75，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1.44 變為 1.2 mW/cm²。用「感測、警報與失效演練」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only ff:0.9→0.75, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1.44 to 1.2 mW/cm². Explain the direction using sensing, alarms and failure rehearsal, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 採樣驗收與追溯~Sampling verification and traceability
units.mechanism: 配對進出水採樣、流量與 UVT／燈狀態，保留檢出限與失效時段，才能解釋降低量。~Pair inlet/outlet samples with flow, UVT and lamp state, retaining detection limits and fault intervals to interpret reduction.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Nin=100000；Nout=100（相同計數單位）。模型 LRV=log10(Nin/Nout)，代入得到 3 log10。適用邊界：需檢測限與回收率；未檢出不能當零。~Original teaching assumptions: Nin=100000; Nout=100 in matching count units. Model LRV=log10(Nin/Nout) gives 3 log10. Applicability: Requires detection limits and recovery; nondetect is not zero.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「採樣驗收與追溯」的觀測點。列出方法回收率、重複樣本與未檢出上限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sampling verification and traceability. Record method recovery, replicates and nondetect upper bounds. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 不同日期或不同水團樣本直接相減。診斷與介入：核對檢出限及水力配對，對未檢出結果使用可支持的下限。~Samples from different days or water parcels are directly compared. Diagnostic response: Check detection limits/hydraulic pairing and use supportable lower bounds for nondetection.
units.misconception: 一次合格樣本保證整個運轉期間合格。~One passing sample guarantees the whole operating period.
units.practice: 只改變 Nout:100→1000，其餘假設固定；結果應由 3 變為 2 log10。用「採樣驗收與追溯」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Nout:100→1000, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 3 to 2 log10. Explain the direction using sampling verification and traceability, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
